---
title: Spatial Placement
---

Detect physical surfaces in real time and anchor virtual content onto the environment using the WebXR Depth Sensing API and surface normal alignment.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Move Camera:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to move forward, left, backward, and right.
- **Elevate Camera:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move down and up.
- **Rotate Camera:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.
- **Aim & Place:** Move the cursor over a surface to preview marker placement, and left-click to anchor it.

### XR Controls

- **Aim & Place:** Point at any detected surface in the room to view the preview marker, and ray-pinch or pull the controller trigger to place it.
